name: lightbridge-skills
description: Reusable skills for AI coding agents — software engineering and radiology/medical-imaging.

plugins.name: coding
plugins.description: Software engineering workflows: commits, reviews, refactoring, and language idioms.

plugins.name: radiology
plugins.description: Medical-imaging tooling references: DICOM via DCMTK, the Orthanc REST API, and 3D Slicer.

plugins.name: medical-ai
plugins.description: Standards and governance references for clinical AI: the MedLog protocol for event-level logging of deployed medical models.

plugins.name: lightbridge
plugins.description: Personal workflow conventions — bootstrap and manage the .lightbridge personal config namespace (user-level, per-project), and keep vendored agent skills in sync with their installed binaries.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Agent-workflow and meta skills: grilling sessions, conversation handoffs, and skill authoring.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Deep-research harness: plan conversationally, execute autonomously into a cited report with resumable file state and pluggable backends.

plugins.name: notebook-tools
plugins.description: Safe cell-aware Jupyter notebook creation, inspection, editing, and clean-kernel execution.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Document conversion and parsing — parse PDF/Office documents to Markdown (routed local/cloud tools), and render Markdown to DOCX.

plugins.name: creative
plugins.description: Creative asset generation — generate and edit images (logos, website/presentation assets, infographics, test fixtures) with OpenAI gpt-image-2 via a deterministic bundled CLI.

plugins.name: privacy
plugins.description: Data privacy tooling — de-identify PHI/PII in text, JSON, CSV, images and DICOM (scan, anonymize, pseudonymize, verify, restore) with Microsoft Presidio via a deterministic, fully local bundled CLI.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Experimental — candidate skills under consideration for adoption, not yet reviewed; may change, move to a proper domain, or vanish.
